CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA -----

For the Petitioners : Mr. Mahesh Tewari, Advocate For the State : Mr. Santosh Kumar Shukla, A.P.P.
.....
Order No.04/ Dated:22.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending their arrest in connection with Siyaljori P.S. Case No. 50 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 1089 of 2022 instituted under Sections 304B, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and 3/4 of D.P. Act, the petitioners have moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per F.I.R. allegation is that informant's niece was married with one Rahul Kumar Ray on 29.11.2021.

It is alleged that just after solemnization of marriage when informant's niece went to her matrimonial home all the accused persons including the petitioners starting showing their dissatisfaction towards insufficient dowry and started demanding Rs. 5 lacs cash for the purpose of self-employment of her husband.
Ultimately, the deceased died an unnatural death at her matrimonial home at the instance of the accused persons.
On 23.07.2022 informant's niece found hanged at matrimonial home.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence at all rather they have been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that petitioner no. 1 is father in law and petitioner no. 2 is mother in law of the deceased.
There is no specific allegation about demand of additional dowry or consequent torture meted with the deceased at the instance of the present petitioners.
Admittedly the deceased was not happy from her marital life because her husband was suffering from epilepsy and usually indulge in abnormal activities with his wife.

During investigation the police found the case true against the husband of the deceased and submitted charge sheet against him, who has been granted regular bail by the Hon'ble court vide B.A. No.13816 of 2022 order dated 17.02.2023.
It is submitted that neither informant nor any other witnesses have whispered any thing against the petitioners showing their involvement in the alleged occurrence.

It is lastly submitted that the petitioners undertake to co-operate with the investigation of the case and also abide by all terms and conditions which may be imposed in the matter of Birendra Nath Ray vs The State Of Jharkhand ......Opposite ... on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180034280/

sentences.text: granting anticipatory bail to the petitioners.
Hence, the petitioners may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State assisted with learned counsel for the informant opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners and submitted that petitioners are in laws of the deceased and admittedly there was demand of Rs 5 las, due to non-fulfilment of which the deceased had died an un-natural death in her matrimonial home while in the custody of the petitioners,
hence, the petitioners do not deserve anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation and materials collected during investigation against the petitioners, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrendering, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bokaro, Jharkhand in connection with Siyaljori P.S. Case No. 50 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 1089 of 2022 with the condition that petitioners shall not leave their present address without permission of the concerned court.
Petitioners shall not indulge in influencing the witnesses of the case or tampering with the prosecution evidences.

They will participate and co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish their mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that they will not change their mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

In case of violation of the terms and conditions the anticipatory bail of the petitioners shall be cancelled by the learned trial court itself on the application of the I.O.
(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
